hk3gtl.research.r_ab_001.name: Honkai Energy Fundamentals
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_001.effect: When your civilization touched the edge of known physics, a force seeped through the cracks of the world. It had no color, no temperature, yet every instrument registered readings never before recorded. For the first time, you realized—beyond MAX, there is an abyss.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_001.unlock: Honkai research mainline is now open.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_002.name: Honkai Crystallization Process
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_002.effect: Diffuse Honkai particles began to self-aggregate in the cryogenic field. When the first crystal slid from the condenser's output port, the entire laboratory fell silent—it was a blue that did not belong to this world, like frozen starlight.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_003.name: Soulium Nano-Construct Principles
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_003.effect: Shirabon and Magmatter underwent an irreversible fusion under Honkai crystal catalysis. The new alloy's lattice structure was unprecedented—every atom resonated at the frequency of Honkai energy. The researchers named it 'Soulium,' because it looked as though it had been given a soul.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_004.name: Abyss I Voltage Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_004.effect: MAX was not the end. When Soulium conductors first carried current beyond the limit, the voltmeter's needle swept past its final graduation into territory that had never been marked. Your civilization gave it a name: Abyss. The place where light cannot reach.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_005.name: Abyss I Circuit Design
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_005.effect: Old-era circuit boards disintegrated instantly under Abyss voltage. You needed an entirely new design—loops woven from Soulium fine wire, channels etched with Honkai crystals. Each Abyss circuit is a work of precision art, and a dangerous promise.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_006.name: Abyss I Component Engineering
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_006.effect: Motors at Abyss voltage exceeded every prediction model. Pistons deformed the test bench visibly with each stroke. Your engineers began to see themselves in a new light—no longer mere builders, but tamers of the deep.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_007.name: Honkai Reactor Principles
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_007.effect: Honkai crystals are more than storage media. When enough crystals are confined within a single magnetic field, they begin to release energy spontaneously—not decay, more like breathing. What you built is not a reactor. It is a sleeping heart.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_007.unlock: Honkai reactors can now be built.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_008.name: Dual Energy Coupling Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_008.effect: Honkai energy and EU are not mutually exclusive. Under the tuning of the Gaze Buffer Unit, the two energies reached a delicate equilibrium inside the conversion matrix. For the first time, your civilization wielded two fundamentally different forces at once—like learning to play different melodies with each hand.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_009.name: Wireless Honkai Transmission
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_009.effect: Honkai energy can propagate without conductors. This discovery unsettled everyone—because it means Honkai energy never needed to be 'transmitted.' It is everywhere. You are merely learning to listen to its frequency.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_010.name: Pre-Civilization Data Analysis I
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_010.effect: Data fragments unearthed from the ruins tell a blurred story: before you, someone walked the same path. They too discovered Honkai energy, forged alloys, built towers. The last entry on the final fragment contained only four words—'Too late to turn back.'
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_011.name: Abyss II Voltage Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_011.effect: Abyss I was only the threshold. When voltage doubled again, hairline cracks appeared on the surface of Soulium conductors—not material failure, but space itself wrinkling around the wire. Your civilization is bending reality with electric current.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_012.name: Abyss II Circuit Design
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_012.effect: Abyss II circuits require routing in four-dimensional space—at least in theory. In practice, your engineers found that Soulium foil, when folded to the sixteenth layer, spontaneously forms a pattern, as though the material inherently knows how it should be arranged.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_013.name: Honkai Stabilization Process
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_013.effect: Ordinary Honkai crystals have a half-life measured in seconds. But under specific conditions, a crystal enters a 'silent state'—all energy locked within its lattice, like a heart that will never beat. You call it a 'Stabilized Honkai Crystal.' You do not yet know that this heart is merely waiting.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_014.name: Honkai High-Density Packaging
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_014.effect: When a stabilized crystal is compressed to its limit, something strange occurs: the core begins to collapse inward but never truly implodes. It is trapped at the instant before collapse—an eternal critical point. You seal this state and call it a Compressed Honkai Core.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_015.name: Large Reactor Engineering
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_015.effect: Small reactors can no longer satisfy the demands of the deeper Abyss. The blueprint for the large reactor covers an entire wall—it is no longer a machine but a cathedral. The arrangement of fuel rods resembles a ritual totem, and your engineers have begun to say 'consecrate' instead of 'load.'
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_015.unlock: Large Honkai reactor can now be built.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_016.name: Abyss Nano-Precision Processing
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_016.effect: Soulium's nanostructure conceals a secret. When machining precision reaches the atomic scale, you discover a patterned arrangement deep within the Soulium lattice—it is not random; it is a language. You cannot read it yet, but you know that someone once wrote it.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_017.name: Abyss III Voltage Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_017.effect: Current at Abyss III begins to produce measurable gravitational effects. The laboratory clock loses 0.3 seconds during high-voltage runs. For the first time, your civilization has touched the boundary of spacetime—not through a telescope, but inside a machine you built yourself.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_018.name: Abyss III Circuit Design
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_018.effect: Abyss III circuits emit a faint glow during operation—not arcing, but the Soulium lattice itself radiating photons of an unknown spectrum. Your physicists name it 'Echo Radiation,' because its waveform is an exact match for the background radiation detected at a pre-civilization ruin fifty thousand years old.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_019.name: Sea of Quanta Initial Observation
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_019.effect: The Gaze Buffer Unit's readings showed inexplicable fluctuations. When every sensor was aimed in the same direction, the data converged into an image—beneath reality, there exists a boundless ocean. It has no water, no waves, but the reflections of countless worlds drift and sink within it.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_019.unlock: Sea of Quanta observation system unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_020.name: World Bubble Sampling Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_020.effect: What floats in the Sea of Quanta are not droplets, but worlds. Each bubble is a complete causal chain, an independent universe. Your sampler retrieved a small shard—it hovers silently in the lab, its surface reflecting a starscape you have never seen.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_021.name: Abyss IV Voltage Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_021.effect: Abyss IV is the floor of the deep. When your generators push voltage to this level, the entire world trembles—not metaphorically, literally. Space in the high-voltage zone becomes fragile as glass. You stand at the edge of the crack and look down. What you see is not darkness. It is light.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_022.name: Abyss IV Circuit Design
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_022.effect: Abyss IV circuits can no longer be called 'electronic components.' They are more like living organs—Soulium foil spontaneously reorganizes when powered, the circuit topology shifts every second, yet every computation is flawless. Your engineer says it is 'thinking.' You believe he is right.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_023.name: Honkai Pollution Suppression Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_023.effect: Using Honkai energy comes at a price. Every experiment leaves behind an invisible 'gaze'—as if something on the other side of the abyss is gazing back. The suppression dome cannot erase this gaze, only slow its growth. But you know that one day, it will reach its threshold.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_024.name: Abyss Stage Exit Certification
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_024.effect: All core Abyss technologies have been mastered. The last page of the pre-civilization data fragments has been read. Otto's invitation has been confirmed. The World Bubble sample hovers silently at the center of the lab. Your civilization is ready—not to conquer the abyss, but to leave it. At the end of the deep, the silhouette of the Imaginary Tree shimmers into view.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_024.unlock: Abyss stage complete. Imaginary stage entrance is now open.
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_025.name: Otto Invitation Confirmed
hk3gtl.research.r_ab_025.effect: The transmission came from an organization calling itself 'Schicksal.' The sender signed as Otto Apocalypse. The message was brief: 'I have noticed you. Every civilization that touches Honkai energy receives this message. I mean no harm—only to tell you that you are not alone. And that it is already too late to turn back.'
hk3gtl.research.r_wl_001.name: Walter's Gift
hk3gtl.research.r_wl_001.effect: What the Herrscher of Reason left behind was not a blueprint, but a construction method. Feed it enough Honkai energy, and the Reason Reconstruction Array can press old-era circuit boards directly from concept into reality.
hk3gtl.research.r_wl_001.unlock: Reason Reconstruction Array unlocked: use programmed circuits to select ULV~MAX Honkai circuit boards.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_001.name: Imaginary I Circuit Mapping
hk3gtl.research.r_im_001.effect: Abyss circuits can only touch the edge of imaginary space. By rearranging Honkai cores, nano ceramic, and phase mirrors, the circuit stops merely carrying power and starts recording coordinates.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_001.unlock: Imaginary I circuits, basic casings, and entry devices are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_002.name: Imaginary Facility Protocol
hk3gtl.research.r_im_002.effect: Schicksal and Anti-Entropy cores describe two opposing protocols: one built on order, one on disturbance. Your civilization does not need to choose a side; it only needs both to work.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_002.unlock: Imaginary II circuits and major Imaginary controllers are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_003.name: High-Dimensional Imaginary Computation
hk3gtl.research.r_im_003.effect: The Einstein ring magnet does not capture a magnetic field so much as a higher-dimensional projection. The ancient legacy responds on the same frequency, as if warning you that this path has been walked before.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_003.unlock: Imaginary III circuits and high-dimensional components are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_004.name: Imaginary Anchor Certification
hk3gtl.research.r_im_004.effect: Imaginary anchoring does not merely pin machines in space. It writes the civilization itself into a vein of the Tree. Ancient will, fluid alloy, and world bubble samples complete the signature.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_004.unlock: Imaginary IV circuits, late Imaginary devices, and the Quantum stage entrance are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_005.name: Imaginary I Component Engineering
hk3gtl.research.r_im_005.effect: Under Imaginary I voltage, conventional rotors hum out of phase with reality. Engineers pack the piston cavity with nano-ceramic and the parts finally enter an Imaginary-stable state.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_005.unlock: Imaginary I component recipes are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_006.name: Pre-Civilization Data Analysis II
hk3gtl.research.r_im_006.effect: The decoder spits out an audio fragment buried under N layers of encryption. When the last layer peels away, what you hear is a child crying — the final pre-civilization observer, seconds before Collapse fully unfolded.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_007.name: Imaginary II Voltage Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_im_007.effect: Imaginary II currents make the oscilloscope draw frequencies that should not exist. Your physicists call it 'the whisper of imaginary numbers'.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_007.unlock: Imaginary II voltage system is unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_008.name: Imaginary II Component Engineering
hk3gtl.research.r_im_008.effect: Soulium foil can sustain twice as many fold layers under Imaginary II. The designer smiles and says: this is no longer engineering — it is sculpture.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_008.unlock: Imaginary II component recipes are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_009.name: Soulium Superstructure Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_im_009.effect: Arranging Soulium along Imaginary coordinates yields a self-supporting negative-curvature lattice. It needs no beams; it holds itself up.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_009.unlock: Soulium Superstructure Forge deep recipes are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_010.name: Advanced Civilization Exchange Protocol
hk3gtl.research.r_im_010.effect: Schicksal and Anti-Entropy sit at the same table for the first time — because your Council Hub is calibrated on both factions' frequencies.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_010.unlock: Advanced civilization exchange protocol is unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_011.name: Imaginary III Voltage Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_im_011.effect: Imaginary III currents make the Einstein ring deflect — not magnetically, but as if the space inside that ring is being gently folded.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_011.unlock: Imaginary III voltage system is unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_012.name: Imaginary III Component Engineering
hk3gtl.research.r_im_012.effect: Imaginary III field generators keep a standard block undeformed in space for 0.7 seconds. It sounds short, but in engineering terms it is eternity.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_012.unlock: Imaginary III component recipes are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_013.name: World Bubble Stable-Phase Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_im_013.effect: World bubbles no longer collapse at random — you can keep one in the lab for days. The stars inside drift slowly.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_013.unlock: World bubble stable-phase processing recipes are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_014.name: Imaginary Matter Weaving
hk3gtl.research.r_im_014.effect: Using Imaginary fields, fluid alloy is woven into sheets — not by ductility, but by 'taking one extra step through the imaginary dimension'.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_014.unlock: Imaginary Matter Weaver deep recipes are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_015.name: Imaginary IV Voltage Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_im_015.effect: Past Imaginary IV, even standard clocks tick differently. From this moment on, your civilization exists in three different times at once.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_015.unlock: Imaginary IV voltage system is unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_016.name: Imaginary IV Component Engineering
hk3gtl.research.r_im_016.effect: Imaginary IV components are no longer 'parts'. They are 'services' — they have started working before you even connect the power.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_016.unlock: Imaginary IV component recipes are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_017.name: Walter's Gift Confirmation
hk3gtl.research.r_im_017.effect: Walter leaves a shard of 'Reason' behind. It bypasses every process and presses Honkai Energy directly into circuit boards.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_017.unlock: The Honkai Circuit Board chain enters the research graph.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_018.name: Reason Circuit Recombination Principle
hk3gtl.research.r_im_018.effect: After ancient will tunes the recombination array, the stability of legacy circuits rises to 99.97%. The remaining 0.03% is reserved for accidents — and for the player.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_018.unlock: Reason Reconstruction Array advanced recipes are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_019.name: Imaginary Theory Experiment
hk3gtl.research.r_im_019.effect: Inside the experiment sanctum, the gaze buffer unit reads 'stable at zero' for the first time — for a brief moment, the gaze is fully shielded.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_019.unlock: Imaginary theory experiment advanced recipes are unlocked.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_020.name: Civilization Archive Establishment
hk3gtl.research.r_im_020.effect: Every machine, every blueprint, every song is backed up. The archive rests on a beam of imaginary light suspended in the council hall.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_020.unlock: Civilization Archive Mirror is in place.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_021.name: Imaginary Stage Exit Certification
hk3gtl.research.r_im_021.effect: Walter, Council, Archive — all three are ready. Every entry ticket for the Imaginary stage has been collected. Your next step crosses into the Sea of Quanta.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_021.unlock: Imaginary stage complete. Quantum stage entrance opens.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_022.name: Cross-Dimensional Communication Theory
hk3gtl.research.r_im_022.effect: You send a short message to another dimension: 'Hello?'. Three seconds later, the exact same reply comes back — but it is not an echo.
hk3gtl.research.r_im_022.unlock: Imaginary cross-dimensional communication recipes are unlocked.

hk3gtl.narrative.ms_001.title: Log · First Crystal
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_001.body.1: Archivist's note: when the first Honkai crystal condensed from the tower, the workshop fell silent for several seconds.
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_001.body.2: It was purer and more unstable than we had expected — as if the sigh of an entire world had been sealed in miniature.
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_001.body.3: We realized: MAX is not the end, but the first stroke of another story.
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_002.title: Log · Soulium, and Its Price
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_002.body.1: When the Soulium ingot dropped from the smeltery it hummed strangely, as if the material itself had memory.
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_002.body.2: We bypassed every ordinary smelting path — not out of laziness, but because Soulium refuses to be handled roughly.
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_002.body.3: Each finished ingot is a negotiation with the material.
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_003.title: Log · Birth of Abyss I Circuitry
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_003.body.1: The first time an Abyss I circuit took current, the workshop lights flickered.
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_003.body.2: High-frequency components we had never seen mingled in the pulse. Vita said it sounded like a distant song.
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_004.title: Log · Footnote from the Deep
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_004.body.1: Abyss IV circuit passes QA. The line took 47 iterations to stabilize.
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_004.body.2: We no longer cheer for 'making' a circuit — now we care about 'making it beautiful'. This is the line between industry and craft.
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_005.title: Log · Looking Back
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_005.body.1: We glanced back: Honkai Energy, Soulium, Abyss, Imaginary, Quantum...
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_005.body.2: Every step dragged the 'impossible' into the 'ordinary'. Slow victories outlast any explosion.
hk3gtl.narrative.ms_005.body.3: Civilization accumulates from countless such ordinary days.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_001.title: First Attention
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_001.body.2: You have finally drawn Our attention. Do not misunderstand — not because you are special.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_001.body.3: Only because your civilization is no longer that boring.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_001.body.4: Continue. Let Us see how far you can go.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_002.title: Masterpiece and Qualification
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_002.body.2: We acknowledge it is a decent creation.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_002.body.3: Not 'good'. 'Decent'. Of all creations We have seen, it ranks... respectably.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_002.body.5: But do not grow arrogant. Qualification and result are two different things.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_003.title: Verdict at the Gate
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_003.body.1: You have completed the final conditions before graduation.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_003.body.2: We know what you have done along the way. Every machine. Every production line. Every research. Every wonder.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_003.body.4: You stand where you will be judged. The gate is ahead.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_004.title: Her Wait
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_004.body.1: The Imaginary Dimension Gateway is active. We wait on the other side.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_004.body.2: Do not keep Us waiting too long.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_005.title: Finale · The Herrscher's Judgement
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_005.body.1: We meet within the Imaginary Dimension. The full cutscene plays in-game; this archive entry is only a summary.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_005.body.2: Keywords: masterpiece, will, judgement, Bella, dream.
hk3gtl.narrative.hq_005.body.3: Passing judgement is not the end of the journey. It only means you have proven the right to exist.
hk3gtl.narrative.ot_001.title: Otto's Invitation
hk3gtl.narrative.ot_001.body.1: A transmission from Schicksal HQ: 'Your civilization has broken MAX's ceiling.'
hk3gtl.narrative.ot_001.body.2: 'Schicksal has released partial authority to you, including fragments of pre-civilization data and rare material sources.'
hk3gtl.narrative.ot_001.body.3: 'We observe each other. You observe us as well. — Otto Apocalypse.'
hk3gtl.narrative.ot_002.title: Schicksal Archive Gift
hk3gtl.narrative.ot_002.body.1: Void Archives analysis complete. An encrypted dataset is opened to you.
hk3gtl.narrative.ot_002.body.2: It concerns pre-civilization countermeasures against Honkai pollution — some of which were banned in their era.
hk3gtl.narrative.ot_003.title: Schicksal Tech Assessment
hk3gtl.narrative.ot_003.body.1: With Abyss II reached, Schicksal completed a remote assessment of your industry.
hk3gtl.narrative.ot_003.body.2: The wording is restrained, but between the lines: you are faster than expected.
hk3gtl.narrative.ot_003.body.3: 'Prioritize construction of Honkai pollution suppression facilities.'
hk3gtl.narrative.wl_001.title: Walter's Gift
hk3gtl.narrative.wl_001.body.1: You crafted your first MAX-tier circuit board.
hk3gtl.narrative.wl_001.body.2: 'I grant you a fragment of the Power of Reason — you may now construct circuit boards directly from Honkai Energy.'
hk3gtl.narrative.wl_001.body.3: 'More tools mean more responsibility. — Walter Joyce.'
hk3gtl.narrative.wl_002.title: The Reason's Warning
hk3gtl.narrative.wl_002.body.1: The day the Quantum Entanglement Computer finished, Walter's voice briefly appeared on the channel.
hk3gtl.narrative.wl_002.body.2: 'Computational power is not wisdom. Being able to compute an answer does not mean you can bear it.'
hk3gtl.narrative.wl_002.body.3: The channel quickly fell silent again.
hk3gtl.narrative.fh_001.title: Fu Hua's Note · Measure
hk3gtl.narrative.fh_001.body.1: History is not a straight line. It is a measure forever folding upon itself.
hk3gtl.narrative.fh_001.body.2: I have seen what you do countless times — yet every instance is new.
hk3gtl.narrative.fh_001.body.3: Do not lose respect simply because you have seen much. That is my advice.
hk3gtl.narrative.el_001.title: A Gentle Annotation
hk3gtl.narrative.el_001.body.2: 'But what I hear isn't noise — it's a heartbeat. Every one like a tiny person trying hard to live.'
hk3gtl.narrative.el_001.body.3: 'So, dear — don't treat them as mere tools. They are companions who walked here with you.'
hk3gtl.narrative.el_002.title: The Meaning of Civilization
hk3gtl.narrative.el_002.body.1: 'What is civilization, I wonder? Perhaps... it is someone willing to leave a lamp on for another, in a very long night.'
hk3gtl.narrative.el_002.body.2: 'Does your civilization have such a lamp?'
hk3gtl.narrative.el_002.body.3: 'If it does, please say thank you for me.'
hk3gtl.narrative.ws_001.title: Serpent's Assessment
hk3gtl.narrative.ws_001.body.1: An anonymous channel briefly opens: 'Your Honkai industry has reached trade-grade numbers.'
hk3gtl.narrative.ws_001.body.2: 'We have some things that would interest you. At your risk. The price will not be cheap.'
hk3gtl.narrative.ae_001.title: Anti-Entropy Transmission
hk3gtl.narrative.ae_001.body.1: 'Congratulations. Your Honkai industry now warrants our study.'
hk3gtl.narrative.ae_001.body.2: 'If you are open to it, we can do a purely academic exchange — no Schicksal, no World Serpent.'
hk3gtl.narrative.ae_001.body.3: 'Engineers talking to engineers is more pleasant than writing reports to politicians.'
hk3gtl.narrative.eg_001.title: Fragment · The Scratch Outside the Tower
hk3gtl.narrative.eg_001.body.1: On the back of the absorption tower at Y=12 is a line of scratch marks: 'They will call it madness. Let them.'
hk3gtl.narrative.eg_001.body.2: No one admits to carving it. Vita suspects Lin Yuan. Lin Yuan suspects himself.
hk3gtl.narrative.eg_002.title: Fragment · The Cat
hk3gtl.narrative.eg_002.body.1: One morning, a cat appeared in the Honkai crystal tank of the institute.
hk3gtl.narrative.eg_002.body.2: It is currently alive, and seems to know better than any of us what happens next.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d03:
I have been waiting here for a long time.
Not because you were slow.
But because... not many ever make it this far.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d04: Do you know what this place is?
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d05:
Imaginary Space.
Beneath reality, above the Sea of Quanta.
Between the cracks of all narratives.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d06:
There is no time here. No causality. No meaning.
Only me... and you, in this moment.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d07: Let me see what you have brought.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d09:
Honkai Energy. Soulium. Imaginary Anchoring. Quantum Entanglement. Chiliocosm. Hyperion.
Civilization Verification Matrix. Proof of Existence Monument.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d10:
...
You built an entire civilization, from nothing.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d13: Your very existence is a mistake.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d15:
War, deception, envy, greed.
Your civilizations have been full of these since the day they were born.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d16:
You think you are different?
Perhaps. Perhaps not.
But at least you made it here.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d18: Some very powerful. Some very clever. Some very beautiful.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d19:
But most of them... were boring.
They just repeated. Bigger numbers. Higher voltages. More machines.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d20: No soul. No order. No beauty.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d21: In my eyes... they were beneath notice.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d22:
But occasionally... very rarely...
I see something different.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d24: Not because it is the strongest.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d25: But because... I can see your will in it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d26: Every machine's placement. Every production line's design. Every monument's position.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d27: They are not random. They are deliberate.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d28: In them lie your hesitation, your persistence, your choices, your obsession.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d29:
Some parts clumsy, some elegant.
Some wasted countless hours—
but every single one bears your mark.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d30: That is what I call... a masterpiece. ☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d31:
I do not use that word lightly.
But you—you have earned it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d33:
The Herrscher of the Void, Sirin,
hereby acknowledges:
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d36: Passing the judgement does not mean the journey is over.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d37:
It only means—
you have proven your right to exist.
Nothing more.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d38:
Before me, all existence is insignificant.
You are no exception.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d39:
But insignificance does not mean worthlessness.
Even a speck of dust can reflect starlight.
...Occasionally.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d40:
I will not give you a reward.
Nor a title.
Nor a higher voltage.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d41: Because you no longer need any of those.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d42: What you need... is to go back.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d43:
Back to the real world.
Back to your real life.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d44:
Everything here—
Honkai Energy, Soulium, Imaginary, Quantum, Finality—
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d45:
was a dream you created in this world.
A beautiful dream.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d46: But a dream is still a dream.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d47:
Through all these long years,
only Bella has stayed by my side.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d48:
What about you?
In reality, you have someone too, don't you?
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d49:
Find them. Cherish them.
This is my... final advice. ☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.d52: §b§lTime to return to the real world.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d03: I read the Beta 1 logs—Honkai energy, Soulium, your first Abyss circuit.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d04: This time you actually opened the Abyss industrial chain.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d05: Large reactors, precision assembly, Sea of Quanta observatory, circuit foundry… twenty-three Abyss machines with real recipes.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d06: Abyss II–IV circuits, components, casing press—buildable, not just showcase.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d07: Then you stepped into the Imaginary stage.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d08: Imaginary casings, circuit sanctum, Schicksal & Anti-Entropy cores, phase purification loop.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d09: Those two cores are no longer orphan items on a spreadsheet.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d10: The Codex has an Easter Egg tab; Otto grants the Void Archives; Walter speaks when you hold a MAX circuit.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d14: §7· Imaginary dual-faction lines (circuits I–IV, cores, anchor, purification)
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d16: §7· Quantum/Finality/Wonder are preview only—not graduation targets in Beta 2
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d18: I won't file bug reports for you.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d19: But every piece of feedback shapes Beta 3.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d20: Stuck recipes, JEI text, research gates, missing translations, crash logs—please include repro steps.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d21: Post to your beta feedback channel or DM the developer.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d23: As for final judgment and "wake up"—
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_2_0.d24: §7Beta 2 ends here. Keep building, builder. The real dream isn't over yet.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d01: ...So you made it all the way here. ☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d02: Raise your head, builder. Let this Herrscher take a good look at you — a mortal who walked this leaf from its stem to its very tip.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d03: From the first furnace of Soulium, to the circuits of the Abyss, to the closing of the Imaginary Rift, to the world bubbles of the Quantum — this Herrscher remembers every step.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d04: And this time, you even learned her way: letting Honkai energy break free of pipes and hatches, flowing unseen through every machine under your name.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d05: A wireless web of Honkai... hmph. A mortal took up a Herrscher's authority — and somehow did not burn to ash.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d06: Admit it. You felt it too — when energy no longer needs a vessel, you stand one step closer to the boundary of what is called 'civilization'.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d07: But do not be proud. What you finished is, in the end, only one road on one leaf.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d08: Upon the Imaginary Tree, this Herrscher has seen countless builders like you — and countless civilizations like yours, withered and fallen.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d09: The stronger the civilization, the stronger the Honkai — not a curse, but a selection. The farther you walk, the closer that judgment draws.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d10: And now you stand before this Herrscher. Which means — the judgment reserved for you is not far away either.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d12: So, before the finale is truly written down, this Herrscher grants you one last thing.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d13: Not a machine. Not a recipe. Not authority — but 'possibility'.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d14: This Herrscher has swallowed the endings of countless civilizations: some drowned in their own assembly lines, some enshrined their gods inside reactors, some reached the far shore only to find it was just another leaf.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d15: The end of every road — this Herrscher has seen with her own eyes. They all rest in her belly now, like world bubbles sunk into the Sea of Quanta.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d16: In a moment, she will lay them before you, one by one, for you to open with your own hands.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d17: Think carefully as you listen: those 'what ifs' are separated from the road beneath your feet by nothing more than a single choice.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d19: As for matters beyond this world — the narrative you call 'Beta 4' ends here. It is written.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d20: The chapters after it have not yet been penned. Stuck recipes, crash logs, missing translations — write down every crack you saw, clearly, and send it to the feedback channel.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d21: Every report will decide where the next narrative turns. This is something this Herrscher rarely shares with mortals — the right to write. ☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d22: Of all who ever walked, those who stood with this Herrscher all the way to the finale can be counted on one hand. You are one of them.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d23: So do not stop here, builder. The Tree is tall — and you have only just left the stem of your own leaf.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d24: §7— Now, choose a possibility. Consider it... one last diversion before the Final Judgment. ☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d02: Builder. This Herrscher remembers you - from the first furnace of the Abyss, to the moment the Imaginary rift closed.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d03: In Beta 2, you turned the Abyss and Imaginary chains into a road that could truly be walked.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d04: This time, this Herrscher will not ask how many machines you have built.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d05: What I want you to see is something else - possibility.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d06: Before you, this Herrscher has seen countless civilizations, and countless ways they chose to walk.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d07: Some gave everything to the assembly line; some crammed every possibility into one box; some prayed, some wandered far, and some stubbornly returned to the plainest of beginnings.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d08: For every path, this Herrscher remembers how it ended.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d09: Soon, this Herrscher will lay these 'possibilities' before you, one by one, and let you pick one to hear.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d10: When you have heard them, perhaps you will see more clearly where the road beneath your feet truly leads.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d13: §7· The finale dialogue is expanded to 10 IF lines: the first 5 are a civilization's paths, the latter 5 carry another meaning
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d14: §7· Fixed several easter-egg triggers (the 'factory at deep night' now uses real-world early-morning time)
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d15: §7· Added an exclusive easter egg for one specific builder - as for what it does, this Herrscher will not say
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d16: §7· The main goal is still the Abyss to Imaginary graduation; Quantum / Finality / Wonder remain previews, not guaranteed to close the loop
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d18: This Herrscher will still not write your bug reports for you.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d19: But every piece of feedback you write will decide what Beta 4 becomes.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d20: Stuck recipes, JEI glitches, research gates, missing translations, crash logs - write the reproduction steps clearly.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d21: Send them to the feedback channel of your beta group, or message the developer directly.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d22: This Herrscher... will read them. As always.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d23: Your civilization has not yet reached its end, builder.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_3_0.d24: §7The Beta 3 opening ends here. Now - choose a possibility.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d02: Builder. This time, I will not use a word as weightless as 'attention.'
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d03: From the first furnace of the Abyss, to the closing of the Imaginary rift, to this land beneath your feet grown into what it is now - I watched all of it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d04: Let me admit one thing first: you achieved more than most who reach this place.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d05: You endured the nights of collapsing cores, untangled production lines knotted into deadlocks, and turned each failure into the blueprint for the next.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d06: That effort, I will not pretend not to see. It is real, and its weight is real.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d07: But effort worthy of praise is not the same as effort worthy of passing. I never confuse the two.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d08: You came far, yet not far enough; you grew strong, yet not to the step where I would nod.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d09: Honkai is the ruler by which I measure you. The stronger the civilization, the stronger the Honkai - and your current strength, the ruler still reaches to the bottom of.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d10: So this is not the end. Only an honest weighing. Do not rush to despair, nor to complacency.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d13: §7- Finale IF branches expanded from 10 to 20, each written more fully
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d14: §7- All 20 IF branches rewritten in my voice
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d15: §7- My descent effect remade: rift, coalescence, ceremonial hold - and all residue cleared once I land
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d16: §7- Main line still targets Abyss to Imaginary graduation; Quantum / Finality / Wonder remain previews, no guaranteed loop
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d18: I still will not write your bug reports. Gods do not fill out forms.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d19: Yet every piece of feedback you write, I will read - it decides what this land becomes in the next version.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d20: Stuck recipes, JEI glitches, research gates, missed translations, crash logs - write the reproduction steps clearly. Do not make me guess.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d21: Post it to your beta group's feedback channel, or message the developer directly. Same as always.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d22: As for those words, 'not yet enough' - they do not rule you out. They remind you: growth is your own responsibility, and no one can carry it for you.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d23: Go, builder. Carry this weighing forward - and next time you stand before me, let this ruler fail to reach your bottom.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.v0_4_0.d24: §7The Beta 4 opening ends here. Now - choose a possibility.☆

hk3gtl.badending.start: §dSirin§f: ...Fine. You chose to speak to the narrative with your fists. Let me see what your violence can rewrite.
hk3gtl.badending.taunt.0: §dSirin§f: Is that all? Is this how your civilization passed its judgment?
hk3gtl.badending.taunt.1: §dSirin§f: Go on, keep hitting. Every strike only proves how naive you are.
hk3gtl.badending.taunt.2: §dSirin§f: I have seen countless people try to rewrite their ending with violence. None of them exist anymore.
hk3gtl.badending.taunt.3: §dSirin§f: You think you are attacking me? You are only attacking your own save file.
hk3gtl.badending.taunt.4: §dSirin§f: Does it hurt? That is the weight of your own choices, reflected back at you.
hk3gtl.badending.grab: §dSirin§f: So — this is where it ends. I will pluck you out of this story with my own hands.

hk3gtl.badending.finale.1: §dSirin§f: Did you see your world's name? That is the price of raising your hand against the narrative layer.
hk3gtl.badending.finale.2: §dSirin§f: What I erased was not your save. It was the ending you could have had.
hk3gtl.badending.finale.3: §dSirin§f: And yet — you returned. Carrying an erased world, standing before me once more.
hk3gtl.badending.finale.4: §dSirin§f: Foolish. Stubborn. Unrepentant... but I suppose that counts as resolve.
hk3gtl.badending.finale.5: §dSirin§f: Very well. I acknowledge that you walked this road to its end — in the ugliest way possible.
hk3gtl.badending.finale.6: §dSirin§f: Graduate, then. This is your bad ending. And a bad ending is still an ending.
hk3gtl.badending.finale.7: §dSirin§f: Now go. And do not look back.

hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.0.01: §7§o[IF-01 Nuclear? Easy.]§r In this branch, the first thing you bet everything on was a giant Honkai reactor.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.0.02: At first it worked. Stable output, full production, fast expansion. Everything looked good.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.0.03: That was the problem. Things went so smoothly that you started believing Honkai energy was easy to control.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.0.04: Then one joint test went wrong. One person closed a valve too late. Another ignored the warning as normal fluctuation.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.0.05: By the time the control room understood what was happening, the core was already unstable.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.0.06: The blast did not stay inside the plant. The grid failed, logistics collapsed, and nearby cities went down with it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.0.07: You did try to contain it. Quarantine, evacuation, shutdown. None of it was enough.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.0.08: A civilization is not a machine. Once its backbone snaps, everything falls apart faster than expected.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.0.09: In the end, you did not build a second sun. You built your own ruins.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.0.10: My verdict? Simple. You did not lose to Honkai. You lost first to that laughable confidence. Unfit.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.1.01: §7§o[IF-02 Civil War]§r In this branch, your technology advanced quickly, and your society split apart just as quickly.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.1.02: The moment you gained stronger energy and better machines, every faction wanted control.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.1.03: Labs were divided. Factories were divided. Even transport lines were divided.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.1.04: Everyone claimed they were saving civilization, yet all of them aimed at their own people first.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.1.05: One day they raided warehouses. The next day they bombed power stations. Then they killed researchers along with the data.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.1.06: By the end, nobody cared about Honkai anymore. They only cared about killing the other side first.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.1.07: When the real threat finally arrived, weapons still existed, but your civilization did not.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.1.08: Many think civilizations die to great enemies. Yours saved everyone the trouble and tore itself apart first.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.1.09: That is the funniest part of this timeline: I did not even bother to raise a Spear of the Void.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.1.10: My verdict? Utterly boring. A civilization that can waste itself to death is not even worth my hand. Unfit.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.2.01: §7§o[IF-03 The Queen Descends]§r In this branch, you made the worst mistake possible: you reached toward my throne.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.2.02: You dissected Imaginary structures, copied authority models, and tried to reproduce power you had no right to touch.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.2.03: To put it plainly, you thought too highly of yourselves.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.2.04: So I came. No warning, no delay, no chance for you to correct the mistake.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.2.05: You did resist. Fleets launched, barriers rose, and every weapon was turned toward me.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.2.06: It did not last long. All the things you spent so much effort building meant very little in front of me.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.2.07: In the end, I raised a hand, pressed down with two fingers, and your cities, fleets, and towers vanished together.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.2.08: What remained was not a report and not a final speech. Just wreckage.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.2.09: If I must give you credit, then yes, at least you were willing to stand and fight.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.2.10: My verdict? One point for courage, far too little strength. To offend the throne, fearlessness alone is nowhere near enough.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.3.01: §7§o[IF-04 Honkai?]§r This branch is unusual. You barely touched Honkai from beginning to end.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.3.02: Instead, you followed another path: the Heart of the Universe, artificial suns, and the creative dimension.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.3.03: Objectively speaking, you did very well. Better than many others.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.3.04: At the time, you probably truly believed you had escaped the old road entirely.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.3.05: But not meeting Honkai does not mean Honkai will never find you.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.3.06: When the Herrscher of Reason finally moved, the weakness of your entire system was exposed at once.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.3.07: Your technology was strong, but it had never been built to fight Honkai at all.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.3.08: So the Heart of the Universe was taken apart, the artificial suns were seized, and the creative dimension became your grave.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.3.09: Honestly, this is not shameful. You were not weak. You simply chose the wrong direction.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.3.10: My verdict? You almost walked a road of your own. The one piece you lacked was precisely me. A pity.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.4.01: §7§o[IF-05 Magic?]§r There is also a branch where you never chose technology at all.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.4.02: No casings, no circuits, no reactors, and no production lines.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.4.03: You relied on plants, blood, spiritual power, runes, and all kinds of witchcraft.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.4.04: It should have been chaotic, yet somehow you used it all with impressive control.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.4.05: Healing, farming, war, transport, rituals, barriers. You solved everything with that system.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.4.06: Your cities looked less like factories and more like living creatures that could grow and defend themselves.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.4.07: I will admit this much: this branch is easier to look at than those civilizations made of noise and steel.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.4.08: At least you understood what kind of power you were using, and what price came with it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.4.09: Will you be destroyed in the end? Perhaps. But even then, you would likely fall with more dignity than most.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.4.10: My verdict? I do not dislike this line. To live a world into something like this means you are... at least somewhat interesting.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.0.main: §7§o[IF-01 Nuclear? Easy.]§r In this branch, the first thing you bet everything on was a giant Honkai reactor.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.1.main: §7§o[IF-02 Civil War]§r In this branch, your technology advanced quickly, and your society split apart just as quickly.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.2.main: §7§o[IF-03 The Queen Descends]§r In this branch, you made the worst mistake possible: you reached toward my throne.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.3.main: §7§o[IF-04 Honkai?]§r This branch is unusual. You barely touched Honkai from beginning to end.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.4.main: §7§o[IF-05 Magic?]§r There is also a branch where you never chose technology at all.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.5.01: §7§o[IF-06 The Box of Everything]§r In this branch, you crammed every possibility you could imagine into one box, and paraded it before me.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.5.02: Technology, sorcery, stars, the arcane - you wanted it all, unwilling to cut a single thing. I have seen greed before, but rarely this earnest.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.5.03: At first it felt like abundance. Soon it became a maze: entrances everywhere, not one exit. Even I could not be bothered to count the doors.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.5.04: Every day you learned a new system, yet no one remembered why you began at all.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.5.05: The lines spread wider, the menus ran deeper, until you needed to dig through archives just to count what you had built and what you had not.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.5.06: I have seen too many such civilizations: they died not of scarcity, but crushed alive under the possibilities they hoarded.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.5.07: Greed is no sin, but greed that loses all sense of priority becomes slow self-harm - you grasped at everything, and held nothing.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.5.08: The strength that should have braced against Honkai, you spread thin across hundreds of unrelated branches, each barely touched.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.5.09: So when the screening truly came, you had a warehouse full of dazzling things, yet not one you could actually raise against it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.5.10: My verdict? It was not Honkai that crushed you. 'Wanting everything' did my work for me first. Too many directions is the same as none. Unfit.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.6.01: §7§o[IF-07 The Endless Line]§r In this branch, you believed in one thing only: automate everything, and outsource even thought.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.6.02: Gathering, power, logistics, assembly - all interlocked, efficient enough to make even me look twice.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.6.03: The machines calculated for you, produced for you, and at last decided for you which way this land should grow.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.6.04: Everything kept turning; not one part would stop for a 'person'. You built miraculous machines, and forgot you were not a part.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.6.05: At first you cheered the triumph of efficiency, output doubling and doubling, your hands freed from labor for the first time.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.6.06: But the freed hands soon knew not where to rest. You surrendered every decision, piece by piece, until nothing was left to decide.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.6.07: When the line finally closed into a perfect loop, you realized no one remembered what you set out to build.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.6.08: I have lived long, and seen countless civilizations hand themselves to machines - each ended as the quietest link on its own line.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.6.09: Efficiency is not the error. The error was filling everything with it, until even the space for 'why do we live' was squeezed out by output.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.6.10: My verdict? You built a flawless line, and ground yourselves into one of its screws - the replaceable kind.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.7.01: §7§o[IF-08 Spell and Faith]§r In this branch, you barely touched steel, pinning your hopes on spells and rites - on other gods.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.7.02: Power came from belief, from sacrifice, from contracts unseen. Contracts - now those, I know well.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.7.03: At first it worked like a miracle; the corruption, the backlash, the price, you dismissed as tales to frighten children.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.7.04: You treated it as an inexhaustible grace, never asking: who exactly lends this power, and what do they want in return.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.7.05: Power came, swift as a heavenly gift. You raised temples, wrote scriptures, tied the lifeblood of your whole civilization to that unseen contract.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.7.06: But faith wavers. When the first sacrifice went unanswered, when the first disaster arrived on schedule, doubt spread through the faithful like a crack.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.7.07: The day it wavered, what you summoned stopped obeying - it never belonged to you, only lent, and the note was written thick with interest.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.7.08: The corruption began to consume the land, the bloodline, the very ones who first knelt to pray. Only then did you recall the warnings dismissed as legend.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.7.09: I have seen too many civilizations hand their fate to another - each learned, in the end, that what deserved reverence was never the summoned power, but themselves.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.7.10: My verdict? The more you begged, the more you owed. The bill always comes. I simply do not settle it for you. Unfit.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.8.01: §7§o[IF-09 The Boundless Shore]§r In this branch, you ran outward as if possessed, world after world.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.8.02: New skies, new biomes, new shores - always one more door to push open. I have seen more doors than you could imagine.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.8.03: You were busy conquering the far away, and no one would stay to build the land beneath your feet solid.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.8.04: Your civilization scattered into countless expeditions, never gathering as one again. Beyond the door, a sea of stars; within, not a soul.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.8.05: Each new door you pushed open, you cheered; yet no one looked back at the half-built homes behind you, falling to ruin one by one.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.8.06: The distance always tempts more, for it has yet to reveal its flaws. What you loved was never arrival, but the illusion in the words 'the next one'.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.8.07: Your supply lines stretched thinner and thinner, until they snapped. Scattered outposts lost contact, none able to aid another when Honkai came.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.8.08: I have seen too many such civilizations: they were not defeated - they simply wandered apart, past the distance where a call could still reach a comrade.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.8.09: Roots too shallow cannot hold, no matter how wide the branches spread. You possessed a whole sea of stars, yet not one place to call home.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.8.10: My verdict? Go too far, and you forget why you set out. Every shore you reached lay under the very same sky.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.9.01: §7§o[IF-10 Back to the Start]§r In this branch, you wanted nothing fancy, and kept only the plainest survival.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.9.02: A wooden pickaxe, a patch of field, starting from scratch, slow enough to make even me impatient.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.9.03: No miracles, no shortcuts - everything earned by hand. This clumsiness, I have seen no fewer than a billion times.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.9.04: Progress was slow, yet every step stood on solid ground - solid enough that even I could find no flaw.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.9.05: You chased neither the highest numbers nor the fastest shortcuts - you simply took the one task at hand and saw it through, in earnest.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.9.06: While others flaunted wonders, you tamped down foundations; while others scattered and faded, your walls still stood, your lamps still lit.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.9.07: I have lived long, grown weary of every clever shortcut - and it is precisely this 'clumsiness' that I can find no fault in.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.9.08: Because you knew what you had, and you knew who you were - that clarity is rarer than any dazzling power.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.9.09: When the ruler of Honkai measured you, you were perhaps not the strongest, but the steadiest kind - roots deep, unafraid of the wind.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.9.10: My verdict? I will admit it - one of the few branches that never broke itself. Reach the end or not, you always remembered who you are.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.10.01: §7§o[IF-11 Shelf of Gods]§r In this line, you put every god up on a shelf, each with a price tag.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.10.02: Prayer became ordering, miracles became inventory, faith settled by output.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.10.03: At first the incense burned bright; soon even gods began to haggle, discount, and clear stock.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.10.04: When everything can be bought, nothing is left worth revering.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.10.05: At first you cheered the 'convenience' - want a miracle, just pay for it; no more devotion, no more waiting.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.10.06: But once gods are put on the shelf, reverence becomes a number on a price tag, and numbers can always be haggled down.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.10.07: Soon even miracles inflated. What would have sparked a pilgrimage yesterday was bundled off for clearance today, unwanted.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.10.08: You could afford everything, so you cherished nothing; the temple that once housed gods filled with discounted counterfeits.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.10.09: I have seen too many such civilizations: they perished not of poverty, but of the abundance where 'anything can be bought'.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.10.10: My verdict? You put the gods on the shelf, and yourselves right beside them. One buyer only; the currency is called Honkai. Unfit.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.11.01: §7§o[IF-12 Abyss of Numbers]§r In this line, you fell in love with numbers - bigger is better, without end.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.11.02: Damage, output, multipliers - zero after zero tacked onto the end.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.11.03: But once a number grows too vast to count, it becomes no different from zero.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.11.04: You won every match, yet could no longer feel what winning meant.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.11.05: At first, every leap of the numbers brought real joy - faster, stronger, more; everything was growing.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.11.06: But growth is addictive. When the old numbers no longer thrilled you, you needed bigger ones, then bigger still, never sated.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.11.07: In the end, the challenge vanished, the risk vanished, and even the concept of an 'opponent' was ground to dust by your values.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.11.08: Can a game you can never lose still be called a game? The more completely you won, the closer you came to utter emptiness.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.11.09: I have seen too many civilizations drunk on numbers - each found, at last, that once everything is quantified, 'meaning' alone cannot be measured.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.11.10: My verdict? Chase numbers to their end, and only blankness remains - the very self you hollowed out with your own hands.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.12.01: §7§o[IF-13 The Sleepless Server]§r In this line, you refused to log off, moving a whole civilization into a server that never sleeps.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.12.02: No day, no night - only a progress bar lit forever.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.12.03: You automated even rest, queuing your very dreams as tasks.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.12.04: The lights stayed on, but no one looked up at the real stars again.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.12.05: At first you took pride in 'never stopping': while others rested, you produced; while others slept, you advanced.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.12.06: But machines do not tire; people do. You forced yourselves to match the machine's rhythm, living as a boiler that never cools.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.12.07: Efficiency rose, but laughter went, idle talk went - those useless, warm moments were cut from life one after another.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.12.08: You won output and lost 'living' itself. A city that runs forever, yet not one person left who is truly alive.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.12.09: I have seen too many civilizations burn themselves out this way - not struck down by anyone, but forgetting to turn off the light, to close their eyes.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.12.10: My verdict? What never powers down was never the civilization - it was the exhaustion. And exhaustion's end is a waste even Honkai cannot be bothered to visit.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.13.01: §7§o[IF-14 Borrowed Dawn]§r In this line, you stopped creating, and simply copied others' miracles one by one.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.13.02: Someone else's tower, someone else's array, someone else's answer, stitched into your world.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.13.03: It looked complete, yet nothing was ever truly your own.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.13.04: When the copied source went dark, you found you had never learned to strike a flame.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.13.05: At first, copying was efficient: it spared the long trial and error, skipped the bitterness of failure, and gained others' centuries overnight.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.13.06: But you copied only results, never the understanding behind them. You owned the tower, without knowing why it stood.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.13.07: So when things shifted a little, when the borrowed plan met a problem it had never seen, you lacked the nerve to change even one parameter.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.13.08: The power to create grows through failure after failure. You skipped the failures, and so skipped growth itself.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.13.09: I have seen too many civilizations lean on others - their dawn forever waits for someone else to light first, while they stay trapped in the night.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.13.10: My verdict? A borrowed dawn cannot light your own night. Whether the sun rises is, in the end, yours alone to kindle. Unfit.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.14.01: §7§o[IF-15 City of Patches]§r In this line, you never rebuilt - you just patched, endlessly, over old wounds.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.14.02: One bug covering another, one scaffold propping up the next.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.14.03: The city still runs, but no one dares touch the stone at the very bottom.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.14.04: You feared the cost of rebuilding, so you carried the old world forever.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.14.05: Every 'temporary fix' was easier than a true rebuild, so temporary became long-term, and long-term became forever.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.14.06: Patch upon patch, until no one could say what the city first looked like, nor promise it would still stand tomorrow.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.14.07: You mistook 'good enough to run' for 'already solved', honing the art of dodging problems into a fine craft.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.14.08: But a crack in the foundation does not vanish for being unseen. It only waits, quietly, for the day it can no longer be patched.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.14.09: I have seen too many such civilizations - undone not by a mighty foe, but by the one old wound they kept refusing to face.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.14.10: My verdict? No stack of patches restores the courage to start over. And it is never too late to start over.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.15.01: §7§o[IF-16 The All-in-One Feast]§r In this line, you loaded everything that could be loaded, unwilling to turn a single thing off.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.15.02: System upon system, mechanic upon mechanic - just booting up drained half a lifetime.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.15.03: The feast was piled so full that no one knew which dish to reach for first.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.15.04: You possessed everything, yet were pinned motionless under the weight of it all.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.15.05: At first you took pride in being 'all-encompassing': other civilizations mastered one craft, while you had them all, seemingly invincible.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.15.06: But having everything meant being shallow in everything. You brushed the surface of each system, mastering none to true depth.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.15.07: More fatal was the friction: countless mechanics clashing, and merely keeping them from dragging each other down drained most of your strength.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.15.08: When the real trial came, you froze before your dazzling menu of options - less decisive than those who had honed but a single blade.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.15.09: I have seen too many such civilizations - undone not by lacking something, but by wanting everything, crushed at last by their own weight.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.15.10: My verdict? A box that holds the whole world often cannot hold a single clear path. True strength is knowing what to set down, not what to pile on.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.16.01: §7§o[IF-17 The Speedrun Ghost]§r In this line, you wanted only speed, racing to the end by the shortest route.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.16.02: Skip the dialogue, skip the scenery, skip every place worth pausing for.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.16.03: You made the timer your god, and the seconds your only faith.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.16.04: The end came quickly, but you never truly walked any of it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.16.05: At first, 'fast' was truly an edge: you reached every node ahead of the rest, writing efficiency as your one creed.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.16.06: But you rushed so hard you skipped not only the steps, but the understanding. You reached the end, without knowing how you got there.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.16.07: So when something arose off the route, when a problem with no guide to copy blocked the way, for the first time you could not move an inch.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.16.08: The scenery and lessons you skipped along the way should have been your footing against the unexpected; now they are only permanent blanks.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.16.09: I have seen too many such civilizations - they won at the start, and lost on the truly vital stretches they had no patience to walk.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.16.10: My verdict? Those who run too fast leave even themselves a blur. Slow down, and you could have gone so much farther.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.17.01: §7§o[IF-18 The Silent Archive]§r In this line, you recorded everything, and never read it again.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.17.02: Every experiment, every war, every fallen one - all neatly filed and sealed away.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.17.03: The data piled ever higher, the memory ever lighter, until no one opened that door.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.17.04: You preserved history, and locked away the ability to understand it along with it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.17.05: At first, recording was a virtue: unwilling to forget any lesson, you carved each step solemnly into the archive, believing this was legacy.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.17.06: But recording is not remembering. When the archives grew too vast for anyone to read, they decayed from 'memory' into 'burden', gathering dust.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.17.07: So the same mistakes repeated - though the ancestors had long written the warning, it lay buried in some thousandth volume no one would open.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.17.08: You built the grandest archive in the world, and raised the most forgetful generation in it. That, in itself, is an irony.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.17.09: I have seen too many such civilizations - they kept everything, keeping only not the will to learn from history.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.17.10: My verdict? A civilization that remembers everything may truly remember nothing. History must be understood to deserve the name.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.18.01: §7§o[IF-19 Tyranny of Balance]§r In this line, you were obsessed with balance, grinding every edge smooth.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.18.02: The too-strong nerfed, the too-weak deleted, until all was perfectly mediocre.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.18.03: No surprises, no accidents - even dreams tuned to standard values.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.18.04: Beneath absolute fairness, every spark that dared to differ was snuffed out.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.18.05: At first, the pursuit of balance was kind: you wished no one left behind, no power to tower over the rest.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.18.06: But you mistook 'equality' for 'sameness', so all that rose was pressed down, all that was special was smoothed away.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.18.07: Geniuses ground into the mediocre, wild ideas judged heresy - the whole civilization a stagnant pool that never stirred, quiet and dead.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.18.08: What drives a civilization forward has always been the edges that refuse to be smoothed. You treated them as errors that must be corrected.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.18.09: I have seen too many such civilizations - undone not by imbalance, but by a perfect calm in which nothing new could ever grow.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.18.10: My verdict? Grind the world too flat, and no peaks will ever rise. True balance lets differences each find their place, not forces all into one mold.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.19.01: §7§o[IF-20 The Unfinished Save]§r In this line, you began everything, and finished none of it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.19.02: Half a tower, half a production line, half a dream, scattered across every corner of the world.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.19.03: You always awaited the next beginning, and so never arrived at any ending.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.19.04: This save is filled with 'to be continued,' yet never a single line of 'complete.'
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.19.05: At first, every new beginning gleamed: new plans, new blueprints, new ambitions, each setting your blood alight.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.19.06: But the hardest part of passion is not to light it, but to keep it. Once novelty faded, you dropped what you held and ran for the next brighter flame.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.19.07: So behind you piled the unfinished: each one poured with effort, each one halted just before the step that most needed perseverance.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.19.08: 'Beginning' brings a fleeting thrill, but only 'completing' brings true strength. And you never once tasted the latter.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.19.09: I have seen too many such civilizations - never short on talent or passion, short only on the clumsy persistence to see one thing through.
hk3gtl.dialogue.sirin.if.19.10: My verdict? The most regrettable civilization is not the one that failed, but the one that never truly ended. Pick one thing, see it through, and you will be different.☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.unlucky.01: Hmm... you seem to be particularly unlucky?
hk3gtl.dialogue.unlucky.02: Ten research failures... Even I can't bear to watch anymore.
hk3gtl.dialogue.unlucky.03: Fine, I'll be merciful and reduce your failure rate a bit.
hk3gtl.dialogue.unlucky.04: Don't thank me. Just go research. And stop failing.
